newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Elan, Dupont Merck to co-promote Parkinsons product.
newsitem.headline: Elan, Dupont Merck to co-promote Parkinsons product.

text.p: Elan Corp Plc said on Tuesday that it had established an alliance with DuPont Merck Pharmaceutical Co to co-promote their Parkinson's disease products in the U.S.

"The purpose of this alliance is to consolidate and clarify therapeutic messages given to physicians," said Nick Teti, president of world-wide pharmaceuticals for Dupont Merck."We hope to be able to impact the quality of life for Parkinson's patients and to seek better patient outcomes."
The alliance will be implemented by the sales force of Elan's wholly-owned subsidiary Athena Neurosciences Inc and Dupont Merck, Elan said in a statement.
